values.note: Every site is a basic (no-hookup) site: $28 a night in November 2026 and June 2027, $20 in March-April 2027; Saturday the same as a weekday. A daily vehicle pass ($10-$12 with Colorado plates, $15-$17 without) or an annual Colorado state parks pass is required on top; CPW's reservation fee is charged per stay.

note: No-hookup loops on the west side of Rifle Gap Reservoir, on higher ground set back from the shore: Sage (central, near the boat ramp and swim beach; the only campground where ATVs/OHVs may ride out onto BLM land) and Pinon (five secluded sites among pinyon and juniper, with hammock stands). --Claude
summary: CPW pages, brochure and cpwshop: confirmed no hookups, 19 sites with pull-throughs, drinking water, reservation-only on cpwshop. Fees 28/28 -> 20/28 ($20 March-April, $28 otherwise). Added max 115 ft (Sage), dump, no flush toilets/showers (brochure), 14-day max, url/window, booking.season Apr 1 - Nov 30. Cleared the note-derived season year_round true (no bookings Dec-Mar, no statement for these loops). Vault toilets left as stored (the brochure says only 'restroom facilities'). Note: dropped the 'Open year-round' (wrong), counts, water hydrant, toilet and reservable restatements.
flags: Split question: the evidence points to ONE campground, not three entries. All five Rifle Gap loops branch off a single park road (OSM 'Rifle Gap Road') along the north shore from the main entrance at the visitor center, within ~0.9 km of each other, none with its own entrance; Sage, Pinon and Cedar sit together at the west end (Cedar's sites center ~300 m east of Pinon's). CPW and cpwshop treat it as one park/one listing (parkID 50038) with five loops. Pin 39.6356,-107.755 is at Sage's centroid; Pinon's sites center ~250 m south (39.63334,-107.75432).
